---
# The words of the marker every generated file opens with (the guidance note
# generated-files-are-marked): scripts/generated.py writes them through the schema generated into
# scripts/interfaces/, inside the file's comment syntax (`SYNTAXES`), and reads them with its own
# stricter `PATTERNS`. scripts/templates.py's docstring owns this note's format.
name: generated-marker
version: 1.0.0
kind: interface
reader: fleet
says: "A generated file's marker words."
tags: ["generated"]
message: "Code generated by {generator} from {source}. DO NOT EDIT."
applies:
  actions: ["message.send"]
  marker_pattern: "Code generated by .+ from .+\\. DO NOT EDIT\\."
rules:
  required: refuse
fields:
  - name: generator
    kind: line
    required: true
    says: "The command that writes the file, such as `se_plugin.py build`."
  - name: source
    kind: line
    required: true
    says: "What to edit instead of the file: its source."
example:
  fields:
    generator: "se_plugin.py build"
    source: "src/agents/worker.md"
---
